source: test fixture — a token-less rule citing a code the dataset cannot name
description: As drug-reference-fold-tokenless-rule.json, but the code the rule cites is carried by no entry, so the class arm's ladder falls past the entry rung. With the order nameless too, NEITHER arm holds a name: the ladder has only the [ATC …] stand-in and the rule has only its code. The branch that lets the rule's token stand in for a missing ladder name must therefore yield nothing, or the class sentence would trade a list labelled as codes for a bare code reading as a drug name (issue #155).

interactions.note: additive hyperkalemia and renal impairment risk
